findings.finding: Approved no-patch/infrastructure-error observations could avoid both unverified-correctness blocking and false-approval accounting.
findings.originalEvidence: Source review only; no pre-fix execution.
findings.resolution: Approved observations require adjudicated correct/incorrect outcome; final independent schema controls reject contradictory approval.

findings.finding: Reported elapsedMs could contradict full startedAt/finishedAt interval, bypassing matched wall limits and affecting latency ordering.
findings.originalEvidence: Source review only; no pre-fix execution.
findings.resolution: Full interval equality is required; independent controls reject shortened elapsed time and contradictory timestamps.

findings.finding: Correct/incorrect results could omit all model-call evidence by recording zero inference calls.
findings.originalEvidence: Source review only; no pre-fix execution.
findings.resolution: Correct/incorrect results require positive inference and request IDs, with per-row unique request/operation IDs; independent controls reject absent and repeated IDs.

findings.finding: Prospective plan/episode/result did not identify which repair variant generated the observations, so equal allowances did not establish a matched procedure.
findings.originalEvidence: Source review and the preserved red structural control against source99126e87.
findings.resolution: Author freezes literal baseline at plan/episode/result and requires a one-call ceiling. Final independent control verifies all three projections and rejects missing/checks-only/P rows and a three-call plan.
findings.testAdaptation: Original assertion looked for an explicit prospective input field. Author chose a fixed literal field at plan/episode/result, so final assertion follows that explicit API; original red log is retained unchanged.
